# pyDEXPI: separate program

Licence AGPL-3.0 (see repo/). ShipBrain copies it unchanged, builds it and runs it as its own program; it is never imported into ShipBrain's code and never modified (changes go to its author). Its code is searched and trained on, allowed by the owner (shipbrain/licence_mode.json); ShipBrain and its models stay open under the same terms.
